plan: reports/plans/2026-10-28_plan_qwen-sft.md, Amendment 1 and its Gates; E40's results/predictions.json stands unedited for E40
filed: 2026-10-28, before any stage of experiments/qwen_sft/amend1.py; values marked provisional are replaced by the rehearsal's measurements (results/amend1_rehearse/) before the pod run, and never after it
scored_by: experiments/qwen_sft/run.py `score` (rules) and `Job.check` (early: each missed check stops the job; --rehearse logs it instead)
quantities: as results/predictions.json, with: F1 = SFT under transformers.get_cosine_schedule_with_warmup(10, 100), peak 1e-5, clip 1.0; read steps = rules.read_steps; the positive control's teacher = W0 + the change of offsets alpha*R (R ~ N(0,1), seed 0) on the alive columns, alpha sized so KL(teacher || W0) on 8 maths rows equals F1's KL to start at its first read step; maths-row readings reported, not scored (card decision-qwen-maths-adversary), against W0's maths reading at seeds 0-2 in G1

G_control.rule: as E40: G1's FineWeb masked KL and seed-0 adversary within the relative tolerances of experiments/qwen_adversary (filed numbers, not read from any results file); a NaN misses

G.rule: as E40 (reported; G1 does not stop on it)

L_control.rule: control: L's KL to start after one AdamW step at 1e-5 within +-tol (relative) of E40's step 1 on the same batch and rows; a missing value or NaN misses

L_scaling.rule: KL at 1e-6 over KL at 1e-5 in [band] inclusive (first-order scaling gives about 0.01); a zero KL at 1e-5 or NaN misses

read_steps.rule: D1 and T1 read steps: fixed, plus the first saved step whose KL to start >= kl_min when it is not already one of them; applied after F1; when B's budget allows fewer, the smallest step not in fixed goes first, never 10 or 100. Mirrored in amend1.py's config (asserted equal at start); the user may change it

T0.rule: positive control (replaces E40's T0): teacher training towards W0 + a random change the student can match exactly, 300 steps; fall = mean training KL of the last 10 steps / step 1's <= fall_max, and the trained student's FineWeb adversary ratio in [band] inclusive
T0.provisional: steps, from the rehearsal's rate check (TR)

P0.rule: as E40 (A0 accuracy; F1's step-0 readings exactly 0)

P1.rule: as E40, on F1 at step 100

P2.rule: as E40, re-pointed: D1's ratio at its first read step <= step1_max holds; at step 100 > line 'sees the update', <= line 'blind on web text'

P4.rule: as E40, on T1 at every read step

P5.rule: teacher training over do-nothing on maths rows at step 100: ratio = T1's adversary / D1's (same seed) <= ratio_max; a seed-0 ratio in [band] inclusive is re-read at seeds 1 and 2 (both states) and the mean of the per-seed ratios decides

P6.rule: accuracy: F1's step-100 GSM8K strict drop-rule accuracy minus A0's, paired on the problems fitting at both, in [band] inclusive (E40's constant-rate fine-tune fell by 0.16); no pairs or NaN misses

three_starts.rule: as E40 for every FineWeb ratio; the spend guard stops extra starts once this job's spend exceeds guard_share x --budget-left (the seed-0 ratio then decides, reread_skipped_budget recorded)

finite.rule: a NaN or infinity in any loss, gradient norm, KL or adversary reading is a miss

memory.rule: peak GPU memory of a stage <= tol x amend1.py's mem_gb estimate, after each adversary start, teacher-training step 2, F's step 1 and the stage's end

bench.rule: B: teacher-training peak <= peak_gb_max; usable host RAM (physical, cgroup limit) >= host_gb_min; the disk pre-flight fits; B's projection fits --budget-left with 2 read steps

adv_step0.rule: each adversary start's step-0 KL (one pass, random sources), checked as it is logged: B and G1 at a traced seed within tol (relative) of the first runs' traces (experiments/qwen_adversary run.log, E40 G); every other start within [state_low x G1's seed-0 reading, G1's + state_add]

adv_pass.rule: each adversary start's first pass within tol (relative) of B's

F_step1.rule: F1's step-1 loss (at W0, the first batch) within loss_tol (relative) of E40's; its rate is 0, so delta-W and the KL to start after it are exactly 0

F_first_live.rule: at the first step with a nonzero rate (step 2): |delta-W| per matrix / (rate x sqrt(numel)) in [band]. Adam's per-entry step is at most about the rate (bound 1.0013 at its second step) and below it where the two first gradients disagree; step 1 at rate 0 has already filled Adam's moments, so the ratio is not 1 within 1e-3
F_first_live.provisional: lower end, from the rehearsal's full-size F1 on the L40

F1_early.rule: F1's KL to start after the first step with a nonzero rate <= kl_max (code check, not a prediction)

teacher_first.rule: teacher training: step 1's training-forward KL within fp32_tol (relative) of the fp32 KL(teacher || W0) on the same batch when that is >= fp32_min; exactly 0 within zero_kl_max when the teacher is W0 (B); at step end_at, the mean KL of the 10 steps before it <= end_frac x step 1's
teacher_first.provisional: fp32_tol from the rehearsal's measured gap (checks.json, 'step-1 KL vs fp32'); end_frac from TR

reported: every number of every stage; maths-row readings of D1, T1 and the positive control against W0's maths readings at seeds 0-2 (unscored); A0's first batch against the earlier run's answers (share differing); the read steps chosen; the benchmark projection with its worst-case re-reads
edge_cases_checked: tests/test_qwen_sft.py and tests/test_qwen_sft_amend1.py: L at both ends of its tolerance, NaN and a zero KL at 1e-5; read_rule with the first KL step absent, equal to 10, before 10, NaN KLs, and a budget of 2 (the optional step dropped, never 10 or 100); P5 at 0.8 and in its band (three starts); P6 at both ends, no pairs; the positive control's fall at 0.2, a zero first KL; the schedule against transformers' own at every step
